an4.78:1.3: atthi bhikkhave dakkhiṇā dāyakato visujjhati no paṭiggāhakato.
an4.78:1.4: atthi bhikkhave dakkhiṇā paṭiggāhakato visujjhati no dāyakato.
an4.78:1.5: atthi bhikkhave dakkhiṇā neva dāyakato visujjhati no paṭiggāhakato.
an4.78:1.6: atthi bhikkhave dakkhiṇā dāyakato ceva visujjhati paṭiggāhakato ca.
an4.78:2.1: kathañca bhikkhave dakkhiṇā dāyakato visujjhati no paṭiggāhakato?
an4.78:2.2: idha bhikkhave dāyako hoti sīlavā kalyāṇadhammo, paṭiggāhakā honti dussīlā pāpadhammā.
an4.78:2.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave dakkhiṇā dāyakato visujjhati no paṭiggāhakato.
an4.78:3.1: kathañca bhikkhave dakkhiṇā paṭiggāhakato visujjhati no dāyakato?
an4.78:3.2: idha bhikkhave dāyako hoti dussīlo pāpadhammo, paṭiggāhakā honti sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā.
an4.78:3.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave dakkhiṇā paṭiggāhakato visujjhati no dāyakato.
an4.78:4.1: kathañca bhikkhave dakkhiṇā neva dāyakato visujjhati no paṭiggāhakato?
an4.78:4.2: idha bhikkhave dāyako hoti dussīlo pāpadhammo, paṭiggāhakāpi honti dussīlā pāpadhammā.
an4.78:4.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave dakkhiṇā neva dāyakato visujjhati no paṭiggāhakato.
an4.78:5.1: kathañca bhikkhave dakkhiṇā dāyakato ceva visujjhati paṭiggāhakato ca?
an4.78:5.2: idha bhikkhave dāyako hoti sīlavā kalyāṇadhammo, paṭiggāhakāpi honti sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā.
an4.78:5.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave dakkhiṇā dāyakato ceva visujjhati paṭiggāhakato ca.
an4.78:5.4: imā kho bhikkhave catasso dakkhiṇā visuddhiyoti.
